title: You Think Finished Work Stays Strongest in Memory, Yet Interrupted Tasks Grip Twice as Hard
description:
You think finished work leaves your strongest memory trace! Yet an unfinished task grips your mind twice as hard! This is the true story of young Berlin psychologist Bluma Zeigarnik. Here is what went wrong inside a busy Berlin cafe.
